description: This file is a header file defining the interface for a message bus component in a C/C++ project, including function declarations related to message bus management such as engage, initialize, finalize, check, and resource freeing.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_MessageBusEngage
methods.description: Engages the message bus with specified component id, configuration file, and path.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the message bus with user data.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Finalize
methods.description: Finalizes or cleans up the message bus with user data.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Buscheck
methods.description: Checks the status of the message bus with user data.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_FreeResources
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the message bus based on priority and user data.
